observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. South is a wide, front-on, hulking four-legged mass of rounded stone plates with a pointed ridge of plates rising to a peak above the head. North is the rear: a stack of dorsal ridge plates, broad haunches and a short pointed tail hanging down, no face. East is a long-bodied quadruped in profile with a low head on the right, a short tapering tail on the left and a ridge of dorsal plates. Glowing orange seams run between the plates on every facing, and every plate has tan/grey stripes.
observed.south.png: Front view. A heavy armoured head in the centre, made of wedge-shaped stone plates, with two small glowing orange eyes. Massive forelimbs splay outward like pillars, built from stacked cobble-like plates with clawed stone toes. The belly and chest are smaller polygonal plates. A pyramidal crest of dorsal plates rises behind the head. Bright ember seams run between the plates. The plates are banded in horizontal tan/grey/ochre strata. Clean alpha.
observed.east.png: Side profile walking right. A long barrel body covered in large banded stone plates, with small polygonal plates on the belly. A dorsal ridge of spiky plates is tallest over the shoulders. The head is low and blunt like a stone beak, with an orange eye. A short segmented tail sticks out to the left. Four legs of stacked plates end in clawed stone toes; the near hind leg is lifted mid-stride. Orange glowing seams. The body is wider than it is tall. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Rear view. The dorsal ridge runs down the spine into a short pointed tail between two big rounded haunches. Hind legs of stacked plates have glowing seams. The ridge peaks above. No eyes or face. Banded strata on every plate. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom, a crop shows the beast towering over the vanilla human; only part of the body fits in the frame. At 32 px per cell it is about 4–5 cells long and about 3 cells tall, dwarfing the human and the rat. It reads as a striped, spiky quadruped with orange seams, apart from the ground.

reply.subject: RM_FurnaceBeast
reply.image_seen: The shared-scale panel shows three facings of a stone-plated quadruped; south shows its face and broad forequarters, east its barrel torso and tapered tail, north its back and haunches without eyes, and the scale panel shows a massive creature beside a human.

concerns.evidence: South shows broad shoulder plates, large elbow masses and segmented forefeet, with smaller hind limbs behind them. East retains those oversized shoulders and thick, jointed forelegs; its far legs appear narrower through partial occlusion. The long barrel is foreshortened in south. These are compatible quadrupedal views, rather than a change from arms to legs. The measured 35% height spread includes the receding dorsal ridge and body depth in front/rear views and does not establish an anatomical mismatch.

The larger plates have angular corners, fractured surface texture and irregular mineral bands, particularly across the east flank and south shoulders. Dark edges separate individual rocks without forming a heavy outer keyline. The small recessed ember eyes and angular muzzle lack glossy round eyes, a smile or toy-like facial proportions. Rounded joint stones alone do not make the creature cartoonish.
